description.content: This endpoint is used to intiate the micro deposit transaction. The bank routing information required will vary depending on the country. Currently only US and Canada are supported.

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your account ID

(Required) Last name of the account holder - required for associating the bank details (optional if company name is present)
(Required) Account number - required for associating the bank details.

ABA routing number - required for associating the bank details. US only.

Account's email address - Must be a valid email. Required if SendEmail = true
Recipient's email address - Must be a valid email. Required if SendEmail = true
Customer's phone number. Digits only - no parentheses or dashes allowed. US only.
Customer's address line 1. US only.
Account's city - No abbreviation. US only.
Customer's state specified using two character abbreviations (eg. CA, AZ). US only.
Customer's zip code. US only.
The token identifying the bank account to be verified. If token is provided, bank routing info and address are not required.
